name: GREYVIBE
description: WithSecure Labs reports "strong evidence suggesting systematic use of generative AI (GenAI) and large language models (LLMs)" by a low-to-moderately sophisticated Russia-nexus group targeting Ukraine with spear-phishing, ClickFix and fake adult-club lures (Telegram personas). Strong indicators point to ChatGPT, Google Gemini and Ideogram AI (lure imagery) used across the lifecycle, including custom obfuscators (LOOKVALPS, LOOKVALJS, DAYLIGHT, TEASOUP), loaders and RATs (PhantomRelay, LegionRelay PowerShell RATs; FallSpy Android spyware). *Analyst note: WithSecure rates the claim that the obfuscators were LLM-assisted at moderate confidence and does not tie each task to a specific AI platform. Vendor source.* WithSecure Labs
